name: ProjectList
description: A compact project index: one row per project, the whole row a link to its case study. Narrow, a thumbnail, the title and one meta line; wide, aligned columns for project, client, discipline and period.

keyboard: Tab moves through the project links in list order; teaser rows without a page hold no control.
Enter follows the focused row's link.
ariaRequirements: The rows are a list named by ariaLabel; each project is a list item.
Each row with a page is a single link whose name is its visible text in reading order, so the name starts with the project title (WCAG 2.5.3).
The wide layout's column labels are visual only (aria-hidden); every row's cells carry their own text.
Thumbnails are decorative (empty alt); the title names the project.
Teaser rows are not links and state their coming-soon label in text.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-10-17: built for the /work index list view. Reviewed: list semantics and name, one link per row with label-in-name order, aria-hidden column header, decorative thumbnails, teaser rows without links, keyboard path (Tab, Enter) via play function, :hover gated to (hover: hover) so one tap opens a row on touch screens, light and dark themes, forced colours (focus outline Highlight, teaser border CanvasText), 390px width with no horizontal overflow, axe clean in unit tests.

items.description: Projects in display order; items without href (or marked comingSoon) render as muted teaser rows.

comingSoonLabel.description: Label on teaser rows; defaults to the translated "Coming soon".

contentLanguage.description: Language of titles and clients when it differs from the page.

className.description: Additional className for the root element.

forbiddenUse: Use as the only view of a visual portfolio's first impression; pair it with the card grid and a view toggle.
Use for tabular data the reader sorts or compares; that is a Table.
dense: Compact project index: rows of thumbnail, title, client, discipline and period; whole row links to the case study; teasers muted without a link

usage.description: ProjectList is the fast way through a portfolio: every project in a row, scannable by name and client. Use it as the list view beside a card grid, behind a Cards and List toggle, with the same filter and order.

bestPractices.description: Copy client and period verbatim from the project record; leave a field empty rather than inventing one.
Keep the order and filter identical to the card view so switching views keeps the reader's place.
Do not put a second link or button inside a row; the row is one link.
